ma.createWebviewContext()

Create a WebviewContext object to send messages to the web-view component (minimum version: 25.12.0)

Return Value

WebviewContext

The WebviewContext object supports two-way communication with the H5 application within the Webview component.

Attribute Type parameter Description
postMessage Function Any The mini-program can send messages to the H5 application within the web-view component. Combined with ma.postMessage provided by the js-sdk, this enables bidirectional communication between the mini-program and the web-view webpage.
onMessage Function Function The mini-program listens for events where the H5 application within the component sends messages to the mini-program. Only functions are supported; if an invalid value is passed, the message will not be received.

Sample Code

const webviewContext = ma.createWebviewContext();

// The mini-program sends a message to the H5 within the container
webviewContext.postMessage({
  testMsg: '111',
});
// Listen for communication between H5 and mini-program within the container
webviewContext.onMessage((res) => {
  console.log(res, 'DSL Get Message');
  ma.showModal({
    content: JSON.stringify(res),
    title: 'DSL Get Message',
    success: (res) => {
    },
    fail: (res) => {
    },
    complete: (res) => {
    },
  });
});
